name: beautiful-tinygo
description: Write, preview, port and review small, robust TinyGo: four skills distilled from the TinyGo documentation, tinygo.org/x/drivers conventions and Effective Go, with a WebAssembly preview for display programs, koebiten game support, porting from Arduino, ESP-IDF, Moddable SDK, Arduboy and C game SDKs such as PicoLibSDK, and reviews that cite named TinyGo rules.
